objective: Deploy Draw Submission Portal (PR #135) to production
lesson_candidate: Squash merges silently drop Prisma migration folders — always run a migration audit script after every production merge to catch missing columns before users hit errors
root_cause_guess: Squash merge collapses feature branch commits into one, dropping migration folder files that were not cleanly represented in the squash diff. Prisma never errors at startup — it only fails at query time when a column is missing.
failures_encountered: Dashboard crashed immediately after PR #135 merge — Neon missing Project.lenderContactName and Draw.submittedToLenderAt
Same pattern occurred after PR #126 (Phase 2) — paidAt/paidByUserId were missing from Invoice table
